notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.16
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Reduced the bleeding duration from spider collision damage by 60%.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could easily get stuck on certain platforms.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the "Evasion Pendant of the Innocent" to be obtained repeatedly.
[*] Made buff effects more noticeable.
[*] Added reasonable consequences if the mission to rescue Hathaway is not completed in time.
[*] Fixed an issue where loot from dead toxic worm and giant beetles in Breezewood would disappear if not collected immediately.
[*] Added some soldier NPCs at the end of Chapter 2 (does not affect the main storyline).
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.15
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Re-adjusted the prices of all equipment.
[*] Spell System Adjustment: Rebalanced the consumption and damage of all spells, modified the stamina consumption logic for charged spells. Optimized some casting animations.
[*] Fixed an issue where returning an energy stone to Find Cat could result in overcharging.
[*] Optimized the performance of the Star Realm Space and certain spell effects.
[*] Fixed inaccuracies in the UI timer display during spell Arcane Empowerment casting and added casting visual effects.
[*] Modified the background effects of the main menu.
[*] Fixed discrepancies in the initial identification level of certain equipment.
[*] Adjusted the completion logic for the "Reeve's Adventure" quest.
[*] After selling the "Azure Lotus Sachet" to a merchant, it will no longer follow the merchant into the second chapter.
[*] Reduced the meal cost for Oliveira from 50 to 20 yuan.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.14
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the health and attack power of normal monsters and elite monsters appearing in Chapter 2.
[*] Adjusted the attack power and health of all bosses in Chapter 2 to prevent them from being easily defeated. Also, adjusted the casting delay and skill logic for some boss attacks.
[*] Elite monster Venomous Worm's toxins will now slow down players.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Heavy Sword's downward stab from high places.
[*] Item modification: Blood-Wrapped Wooden Stake from an amulet-type equipment to a necklace, and added an additional effect: significantly reducing the player's armor.
[*] Item modification: Now, the Evasion Pendant of The Innocent will restore 25% of the player's health when triggered. Cooldown reduced. Visual effects added upon activation.
[*] Item modification: Reduced the health restoration effect of the "Love" necklace.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.13
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Added a new feature to the map: the World Map, allowing players to easily locate their current position.
[*] The map interface now displays the name of the current region.
[*] The item description interface now shows the current level of identification of equipped items.
[*] Fixed potential issue where the quest wouldn't trigger after perishing in battle with Emeric.
[*] Fixed bug where Dungeon Research quest couldn't be completed.
[*] Adjusted Azalea's appearance logic in the lower level of the castle.
[*] Fixed bug where main quests and side quests couldn't be filtered in the quest interface.
[*] Added blocking rocks in the latter part of Shadow Mountain City to prevent players from reaching the area prematurely.
[*] Corrected the incorrect location name in the quest "Talk to Garrick".
[*] Adjusted the appearance logic of Hathaway and Kenneth on the Wilderness Road.
[*] For the quest involving Hathaway's injury, players will now be unable to trigger it after specific scenarios.
[*] Fixed bug where the "Spell Essence Core" equipment didn't work when equipped.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.12
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Modified running-related animations and adjusted running actions at different speed thresholds.
[*] Rolling can be canceled by jumping, but not when equipped with the Mysterious Turtle Shell.
[*] Modification to Mithril Necklace attributes, added: reduces stamina consumption of all actions by 10%.
[*] Dhravas Boss-related adjustments:
a) Increased attack wind-up.
b) Increased health.
c) Now less susceptible to most of his own spells.
d) Reduced the number of lightning summoned by Lightning spell, increased the interval and distance between each lightning strike to make it easier to evade.
e) Reduced the attack range of Impact spell, providing means to evade.
[*] Renamed "Find Reeve" quest to "Meet New Teammate".
[*] Modified description of Jade Talisman effect.
[*] Fixed issue with character attributes not applying to old saves before the update.
[*] Fixed bug where subsequent quests couldn't be obtained after perishing with Noa.
[*] Empty prison cells in dungeons will prompt players that the cell is empty.
[*] Slightly modified completion logic of Ethan's questline.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.11
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Adjusted rolling speed.
[*] Mysterious Turtle Shell now reduces player rolling distance, increases player's stamina consumption by 10%, and increases rolling consumption.
[*] Double jump now consumes stamina.
[*] Added NPCs on the upper floor of the castle to guide players to discover the library and Dhavras' location.
[*] Collision volume during player's fatigue state now more accurately reflects the actual range.
[*] Modified knowledge level requirements for obtaining Mithril Ring, Mithril Necklace, and Balance Ring.
[*] Reduced defense value of Gold Medal.
[*] Defense Ring will now reduce more movement speed.
[*] Significantly increased attack power of Wager Yield Blade, but its charged damage multiplier changed from 3x to 2x.
[*] Fixed an issue with small font size of item details in inventory at certain resolutions.
[*] Bleeding effect modification (when Bleeding effect stacks, it now also increases damage in addition to extending duration), and corresponding UI display adjustments.
[*] Giant Mushroom Boss adjustments:
a) Increased health of Giant Mushroom's arms and torso.
b) Increased poison damage of Giant Mushroom.
c) Slightly increased poison damage and attack frequency of Mushroom Man and Exploding Mushroom summoned by Giant Mushroom.
d) Increased speed of summoning Mushroom Men and Exploding Mushrooms by Giant Mushroom.
[*] Werewolf Boss adjustments:
a) Increased attack power of Werewolf Boss.
b) Slightly increased attack wind-up of Werewolf Boss.
c) Slightly increased health of Werewolf Boss.
d) Damage received when Werewolf Boss blocks increased from 20% to 50%.
e) Slightly expanded attack range of Werewolf Boss for better visual perception.
f) Distinguished particle effects between blocking and being injured for Werewolf Boss.
[*] Noa adjustments:
a) Slightly increased Noa's maximum health.
b) Increased Noa's attack power and slightly adjusted attack range of Heavy Strike.
c) Slightly slowed down Noa's attack animation to reduce attack speed.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.10
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where opening the menu upon death would prevent the menu from closing.
[*] Fixed a game freeze issue when charging the iron sword in the Star Realm Space.
[*] Adjusted Noa's resilience when using healing skills to prevent easy defeat.
[*] Tweaked camera movement logic during battles with the giant mushroom.
[*] Increased the health of the giant mushroom's arms by 10%.
[*] Adjusted the collision volume of the giant mushroom's umbrella and the bounce of nearby bounce mushrooms to prevent injury when using the bounce mushrooms.
[*] Optimized the projectile effects of flying monsters with ranged attacks and made their attack warnings more apparent.
[*] Added danger signs at the entrance of the spider's cave to help players understand the difficulty of the boss.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.9
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where the interaction function became disabled after encountering the lower-left corner guard in the dungeon.
[*] Adjusted the health values of all non-elite monsters and bosses (including boss summons) in Chapter 1 to reduce the game's difficulty.
[*] Electric Fireflies now correctly display their charging status.
[*] Reduced the height coefficient when calculating fall damage (reducing fall damage).
[*] Slightly decreased the player's rolling speed.
[*] Slightly increased the attack power of the Heavy Sword.
[*] Fixed the timing of NPC display in the mountain town to ensure they appear at the correct time.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.8
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where after quickly closing the menu interface on the map or quest screen, the next time the menu is opened, the map or character interface would appear directly.
Fixed a bug where consecutive normal attacks with the Iron Sword, Heavy Sword, and Gushing Sword would not trigger the fatigue status.
Resolved an issue in the basement scene of Chapter 2 where the hidden path became inaccessible after killing 4 bosses.
Expanded the position of trap barriers below the town to prevent players from easily falling off.
Fixed display issues with UI effects such as low health or low stamina on ultra-wide screens.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.7
notes.notes:
1.Fixed a bug where the short-tailed lizard's jumping attack might behave abnormally.
2.Removed collision volume after the death of the giant mushroom.
3.Reduced the attack power of the Cursed Sword by 1 point.
4.Fixed a bug where Noa's health might not be full during the battle with her.
5.The attack of the multi-winged fly can no longer penetrate walls.
6.Slightly increased the font size of item descriptions in the UI interface.
7.Reduced the difficulty of Emeric:
    7.1.Reduced ranged spell damage by 10%, slightly increased casting delay.
    7.2.Reduced health by 5%.
    7.3.Increased melee damage (Iron Mountain Slam) by 15%, slightly increased casting delay.
    7.4.Reduced sword swing attack damage by 6%.
8.Reduced turtle shell money to 120.
9.Significantly increased the health recovery speed of blood bottles.
10.Greatly increased the energy recovery speed when in a fatigued state.
11.Fixed an issue where elite monsters would not regain health after the player sits by the bonfire.
12.Fixed a bug where the "Find Nearby Maps" quest could be repeatedly received.
13.Added a prompt when entering the next chapter to prevent players from entering the next chapter prematurely.
14.Reduced the amount of money obtained from mushrooms in the Ogden mission from 60 to 50.
